motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: The single curve for every spatial change: stack deploy, landed clip-path, dismiss scale.

motion.name: duration-move
motion.purpose: Duration for every transform / clip-path / --p transition.

motion.name: duration-fade
motion.purpose: Colour or opacity crossfade riding alongside a move (landed opacity, dismiss background and stroke).

motion.name: landed-hold
motion.purpose: How long the landed banner stays open before folding back into the disc.

motion.name: deploy-progress
motion.purpose: One registered progress value; each banner derives translateY(calc((1 - var(--p)) * var(--d))) and opacity var(--p) from it.

components.css: .ds-seg-stage{--ds-card:#1c1c1e;--ds-raised:#2c2c2e;--ds-ink:#f5f5f7;--ds-dim:#98989d;--ds-rule:rgba(255,255,255,.12);--ds-rule-active:rgba(255,255,255,.28);--ds-rule-focus:rgba(255,255,255,.45);--ds-blue:#0a84ff;--ds-lift:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45);--ds-ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);padding:24px;background:var(--ds-card);font:13px/16px -apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}.ds-segments{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--ds-rule);border-radius:8px;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:hidden}.ds-segments label{position:relative;cursor:default}.ds-segments input{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:0;opacity:0}.ds-segments span{display:block;padding:0 10px;font:500 12px/24px -apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ds-dim);transition:background 120ms linear,color 120ms linear}.ds-segments label+label span{border-left:1px solid var(--ds-rule)}.ds-segments input:checked+span{background:var(--ds-raised);color:var(--ds-ink)}.ds-segments label:hover span{color:var(--ds-ink)}.ds-segments input:focus-visible+span{color:var(--ds-ink);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ds-rule-focus)}

narrative.overview:
Bubble for Messenger looks like a macOS notification banner that decided to stay. Every surface is the same material: a solid graphite card, a one-pixel white hairline at twelve percent, and one soft lifted shadow. The disc at rest is that card cut to a circle; a conversation is that card stretched to a banner; the open sheet is that card at 420 wide with messenger.com painted inside it. Nothing is translucent, nothing is tinted, nothing glows. The Messenger mark's own raster is the only colour on screen at rest, and blue appears only where the system has to say "unread".

The system is dense and quiet. Five conversations occupy 292 vertical pixels. Type is the system face at three sizes, and the hierarchy is carried by weight and by ash-grey secondaries rather than by size jumps. Motion is a single idea applied everywhere: one ease-out-quint curve at 220 milliseconds, driving transform, opacity, or clip-path and nothing else. The stack does not animate as five cards; it animates as one number, `--p`, that every banner reads its offset and opacity from.

The build refused two things on purpose and they are confirmed rejections: the incumbent "liquid" goo-and-gradient fan, and the category default of a red badge beside a native-looking window. The dismiss target does not turn red when armed; it inverts to paper.
keyCharacteristics: One material: graphite card, 12% hairline, one lifted shadow, on every surface including the ✕ target
Blue only means unread: the count pill and the 6px dot, nowhere else
System type at 13 / 12 / 11 px; weight 600 is the entire emphasis vocabulary
One motion curve (ease-out-quint, 220 ms), one progress value for the stack, no overshoot, no stagger
The panel is framed, never restyled: messenger.com keeps its own wash and bubbles inside an opaque window with the system's rounded corners and a hairline just inside the edge

rules.name: The Blue Means Unread Rule
rules.body: System Blue appears on exactly two elements, the count pill and the unread dot. No blue rules, fills, focus rings, or links anywhere in the app's own chrome.

rules.name: The No Red Rule
rules.body: There is no destructive colour. The dismiss target arms by inverting Graphite and Paper, not by turning red.

rules.name: The Mark Is The Colour Rule
rules.body: At rest the only chroma on screen is the Messenger icon raster (24px). The system supplies no gradient, tint, or vibrancy of its own.

rules.name: The One File Rule
rules.body: Every value above is written once, in `src/renderer/tokens.css`; the pages link it and `lib/tokens.js` reads it for the CSS the app writes into messenger.com. The sandboxed panel preload carries copies, held to the file by a test.

rules.name: The Count Pill Exception
rules.body: White on System Blue is 3.65:1, under AA for its 11px digits. Kept on purpose (September 2026): it is the system's own badge convention and the pill shows at most two characters; the satellite's blue-on-graphite count is 4.7:1.

rules.name: The Thirteen Ceiling Rule
rules.body: No text the app itself sets is larger than 13px (the initial in a head, at 15px, is a glyph, not a line of text). Hierarchy comes from 600 versus 400 and Paper versus Ash.

rules.name: The Drawn Icon Rule
rules.body: Every icon is an inline SVG in one vocabulary — the ✕, the inbox tray, the pin, the reply arrow, the menu dots — stroked round at 1.6–2px or filled in `currentColor`. No unicode glyph stands in for one.

rules.name: The One Line Rule, with one exception
rules.body: Every text run in a card is `white-space: nowrap` with an ellipsis, and cards do not grow to fit text — except the landed banner's message, which wraps to at most six lines (then an ellipsis) so a message can be read without opening the chat; the banner grows away from the screen edge.

rules.name: The Disc Anchor Rule
rules.body: Nothing moves the disc. Stack, landed banner, and panel all take their position from it, and the disc keeps its screen position when the stack opens or closes.

rules.name: The Fifty-Two Pitch Rule
rules.body: Head rows sit on a 52px pitch (44 + 8). `lib/layout.js` and `bubble-renderer.js` both hardcode it; change one and the fold offsets break.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one shadow value. Elevation is binary: a thing is a card (lifted, hairlined) or it is nothing.

rules.name: The Tone And Rule Rule
rules.body: State that would be a colour change elsewhere is a tone step and a rule change here: hover raises the card one step; active holds that step and brightens the hairline. No new hues, no transforms.

rules.name: The Radius Follows Height Rule
rules.body: Pills (disc, landed banner, count, avatar, dot, pin, chip, satellite, field, target) are radius = height / 2. Controls that sit in a row (segments, the Open button) use 8px; cards that hold two lines (banner, settings card) use 14px or 16px; the sheet takes the system's window radius. Nothing is square-cornered.

dos: Do build every new surface from the one material: Graphite (`#1c1c1e`), a 1px `rgba(255,255,255,.12)` rule, and `0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45)`.
Do use the single curve `cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)` at 220ms for any spatial change, and 120ms linear only for a colour or opacity crossfade riding alongside it.
Do derive grouped motion from one progress value (`--p`) rather than per-item delays.
Do keep radii tied to height: half the height for pills and circles, 16px for the sheet.
Do show state with tone and rule (Raised Graphite on hover; Raised Graphite plus the 28% hairline when active), not with transforms or new colours.
Do leave messenger.com's own content alone inside the frame; the system owns the silhouette, not the page.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, blur, vibrancy, or translucency; the rejected liquid fan is not to be carried forward.
Don't use red anywhere; arming or destructive states invert Graphite and Paper instead.
Don't put System Blue on anything but the unread count and the unread dot.
Don't set app text larger than 13px or use a second family; emphasis is 600 weight or Ash, not size.
Don't animate layout, width, height, or box-shadow; only transform, opacity, and clip-path move.
Don't add a second shadow or elevation level; a thing is either a card or nothing.
